# jamesbrady.org — AI Alchemist

> James Brady's personal site. AI systems, protocols, and programs on a mathematical substrate. Tools that work.

## Pages

- / — Home. Hero + 3 cards linking to Primer, Manuscript, Workshop.
- /primer — The Primer. How coding systems work: what code is, the stack, AI agents, skills, MCP.
- /manuscript — The Manuscript. Curated catalog of 36 tools across 9 categories: Document Processing, Design & UI, Development Tools, Marketing & Analytics, Agent Frameworks, Local AI, Automation, Memory & Knowledge, MCP Servers.
- /workshop — The Workshop. Three practical guides: set up an AI agent (Claude Code), install and use skills, connect MCP servers.
- /about — About James Brady. Bio, philosophy, links.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- /api/catalog — JSON catalog of all tools with name, description, install command, and GitHub URL.
- /feed.xml — RSS feed.
- /.well-known/ai-manifest.json — AI manifest with site structure and capabilities.

## Key Topics

This site covers: AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), Claude Code, skills (agent extensions), developer tools, document processing, vector databases, workflow automation, local LLMs, and the modern AI development stack.
